rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a Day-5 full blastocyst and good ICM/TE, but includes speculative image claims (dark/grainy, possible collapse/notch, no gross degeneration) and some grading confusion.
Integrates age, AMH, BMI, uterine factor, prior live birth, sperm parameters, and lifestyle reasonably well, though some links to embryo-specific prognosis remain broad.
Overall structure is logical, but there are internal inconsistencies in implantation estimates and some hedging/contradictory statements about embryo quality and prognosis.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice (single embryo transfer, uterine cavity optimization, luteal support, caution about hydrosalpinx), though some advice is generic and not tightly tied to formal criteria.

Provides practical next steps for uterine evaluation, transfer preparation, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and future planning, though some recommendations are nonspecific because key uterine details are missing.
